review_source: Claude manual GPS review supplied by Howard Weiss
review_method_summary: Rows were reviewed by comparing the proposed pin against Google Places coordinates for the named facility. Approve means the pin lands on the correct small park/playground or within approximately 150 meters of the actual facility. Do not approve means the pin is wrong, too imprecise for a large park/facility, or requires corrected coordinates.
